# KaTeX 0.16.9

These files are unmodified copies of the official npm package `katex@0.16.9`, downloaded from jsDelivr on 2026-11-06 and byte-verified against the npm tarball:

- `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.9/dist/katex.min.css`
- `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.9/dist/katex.min.js`
- `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.9/dist/contrib/auto-render.min.js`
- `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.9/LICENSE`
- `https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/katex@0.16.9/dist/fonts/*` (all 60 font URLs referenced by `katex.min.css`)

Project page: `https://katex.org/`; source repository: `https://github.com/KaTeX/KaTeX`.

Registry download: `https://registry.npmjs.org/katex/-/katex-0.16.9.tgz`; SHA-256 `a0ccc017a6bff9e9dbc014b324e5203c52df16aeff105d971e916ce65b552733`; npm `dist.integrity` `sha512-fsSYjWS0EEOwvy81j3vRA8TEAhQhKiqO+FQaKWp0m39qwOzHVBgAUBIXWj1pB+O2W3fIpNa6Y9KSKCVbfPhyAQ==` and `dist.shasum` `bc62d8f7abfea6e181250f85a56e4ef292dcb1fa` both match.

The three main files retain the SHA-384 SRI values used by `themes/stack/data/external.toml`:

```
sha384-n8MVd4RsNIU0tAv4ct0nTaAbDJwPJzDEaqSD1odI+WdtXRGWt2kTvGFasHpSy3SV  katex.min.css
```

CSS and font binaries are unmodified. The CSS uses relative `url(fonts/...)` references, so the `fonts/` directory must stay beside `katex.min.css`. All local URLs are emitted through Hugo `relURL` for the `/personal-webpage/` project subpath.

`LICENSE` is the MIT license shipped with KaTeX (SHA-256 `766ccc1f306c885aa45542a9846bbd0a505b27a0374f146778171c2254ce18e3`).
